# Ciabatta — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where does Ciabatta come from?", "Italy"),
    ("What is Ciabatta made of?", "high-hydration wheat"),
    ("What is origin?", "Italy"),
    ("What is base?", "high-hydration wheat"),
    ("What is serving?", "open holes"),
    ("What is note?", "1982 invention"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
